operators.name: custom_rot90
semantics: Equivalent to torch.clone(x) followed by torch.rot90(x_clone, k=1, dims=(1,2)).
clone preserves values and shape; rot90 swaps dimensions 1 and 2, then reverses the new dimension 1 (original dimension 2) to implement 90-degree clockwise rotation.
Output stride [307200, 320, 102400, 1] matches reference; extension may produce contiguous output but values are identical.
Creates a tensor identical to input x (same shape, dtype, device, values).
No numerical computation beyond identity copy.
Rotates x_clone by 90 degrees clockwise in the plane specified by dims=(1,2).
For k=1, dimensions 1 and 2 are swapped and the new dimension 1 (original dim 2) is reversed.
